data.current_description: Request a field-service quote by trade, location, and urgency. Returns availability and quote details when available. Public modeled pricing is available through dispatch.estimate.
data.description_suggestion: Request a field-service quote by specifying trade, location, and urgency level. data.current_description: Create a field-service order and return its status URL. HTTP 201 returns a created order; HTTP 202 returns an order accepted_pending_fulfilment with fulfilled=false.
